verdict.rationale: The product documents two update paths. Marketplace plugins update automatically: the Claude Code plugin "updates itself by default" and the Codex plugin "updates itself at startup." For editable copied files, the explicit `npx skills update` command pulls the latest changes. A runtime probe confirmed the install path works, but nothing in the pack exercises an update. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that `npx skills update` or plugin auto-update actually delivers fixes, and documented update behavior for the Copilot plugin route.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch

citations.quote: pull my latest changes when you want them with `npx skills update`.
installs the whole set as a managed, read-only bundle that updates when I ship
